metric: Dimensionless task-normalized Spearman rank correlation; higher is better. Not accuracy or probability.

rows.label: Best tested AL: medoids initialization, neural-network surrogate, cluster-margin batches

conditions.evaluation: Whole predefined library including training points
conditions.task_filter: Mean Spearman rho>0.1, following the authors' notebook
conditions.normalization: Best seed-averaged algorithm–predictor mean for each task is the task denominator; then average normalized raw values over tasks, predictors and seeds.
conditions.errorbars: SEM of 3220 task×predictor×seed score contributions, following author analysis; not an independent paired significance test.
conditions.level: Independent deterministic reaggregation of supplied results only; no model training or experiment rerun
